articles.title: Quote of the day by Ralph Waldo Emerson: 'A man's wife has more power over him than the state has' - A timeless lesson about marriage, love and freedom in relationships from the father of Transcendentalism
articles.description: Ralph Waldo Emerson's Quote of the Day, "A man's wife has more power over him than the state has," was written in his private journal between 1835 and 1838. The statement explores how personal relationships can exert a stronger influence on an individual than formal institutions and government authority. The quote also connects with Emerson's wider philosophy of individualism, self-reliance and the tension between personal freedom and external influence.

articles.title: Taking a screenshot could make you forget what you wanted to remember, study of 892 people finds. The brain may be ‘offloading’ memories
articles.description: A new study of 892 people across seven experiments found that taking screenshots may make it harder to remember the information being captured. Participants not only had poorer memory for screenshotted artwork but also struggled to recall which images they had actually captured. Researchers suggest cognitive offloading, divided attention and attentional disengagement could explain the effect, while stressing that screenshots can still help memory when they are reviewed later.
